headline: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol Drive Enhanced AI Model Capabilities
summary: OpenAI has released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, significantly enhancing AI model capabilities for complex and everyday tasks. These models are being integrated into various applications, from healthcare to supply chains, driving broader adoption and innovation.
whyItMatters: These models broaden access to advanced AI capabilities, reducing costs and increasing efficiency in multiple industries.
